paper_metadata.title: A 33.6-to-46.2GHz 32nm CMOS VCO with 177.5dBc/Hz Minimum Noise FOM Using Inductor Splitting for Tuning Extension

figures.caption: Figure 20.3.1: Schematic of the Voltage Controlled Oscillator.

references.sentence: In this work, the switched-capacitor tank of the VCO shown in Fig. 20.3.1 is centered around two different resonance frequencies by splitting the inductor through the switch Msw.

To gain insight into the advantages of the proposed technique, Fig. 20.3.2 shows a simplified equivalent circuit of an oscillator with the traditional switched-tankcapacitor CT approach and the proposed alternative consisting of a switch in series with the inductor LT.
Preliminary fabrication of varactors and MOM capacitors has been performed and measured results are shown in Fig. 20.3.3.
Figure 20.3.4 shows a typical plot, for a carrier frequency of 40GHz.
Phase noise at 10MHz offset and the FOM versus the oscillation frequency are shown in Fig. 20.3.5.
Experimental results are summarized and compared to recently reported mmWave VCOs in the Table of Fig. 20.3.6.
The chip micrograph is shown in Fig. 20.3.7.
